两台设备交换 6 位码即完成配对，token 保存在系统凭据库。: The two devices are paired once they exchange the 6-digit code; the token is kept in the system credential store.
这台设备当前不需要配对: This device doesn't need pairing right now
它已经配对完成；若对端不认本机凭据，设备列表会把它标成「需重新配对」。: It is already paired; if the peer rejects this device's credentials, the device list marks it as “Pair again”.
在对方设备上输入此码 · 剩余 {time}: Enter this code on the other device · {time} left
配对码已过期，点「生成配对码」重新生成: The code has expired. Tap “Generate pairing code” for a new one.
或输入对方配对码: Or enter the other device's code
对方在「设备 → 配对设备」中显示。: The other device shows it under “Devices → Pair device”.
先核对两边的码一致，再由对方点「接收」；60 秒没人处理自动作废。: First check that both codes match, then have the other side tap “Receive”; the invite expires after 60 seconds.
对方屏幕应显示同一串；不一致就取消这次邀请。: The other screen should show the same string; cancel this invite if it doesn't.
交给系统安装器安装这个 APK（首次需先允许 OrbDrop 安装未知应用）。: Hand this APK to the system installer (first allow OrbDrop to install unknown apps).
用系统应用打开这份文件。: Open this file with a system app.
复制收件目录中的完整路径。: Copy the full path inside the inbox folder.
仅删除本机收件目录中的这一份。: Removes only this copy from the inbox folder on this device.
「{name}」将从收件目录中移除。此操作不可撤销。: “{name}” will be removed from the inbox folder. This can't be undone.
备注只保存在本机，不会发给对端，也不改对方自己的设备名。: The remark is stored only on this device; it isn't sent to the peer and doesn't change the peer's own device name.
设好之后设备页那一行显示成「备注(设备名)」，会话与标题只写备注本身；留空保存即: Once set, the device row shows “remark (device name)” while conversations and titles show only the remark; saving an empty field clears it.
名册里的设备都不在本机设备表里了。: None of the devices in the roster are in this device's device list anymore.
接受后两台设备互信: Both devices will trust each other once accepted
双方各存一枚 token，之后即可互相发消息、收文件。: Each side stores a token; after that you can message each other and exchange files.
这台设备自称是本机已配对的设备，但没能出示凭据（它可能只是换了地址，也可能不是）: This device claims to be one already paired with this device but couldn't present its credentials (it may just have a new address — or it may not be the same device). Confirm who it is before accepting.
和对方屏幕上的这串一致再点「接收」；不一致请拒绝。: Check that it matches the string on the other screen before tapping “Receive”; decline if it doesn't.
